rulebook.name: Trend rider
rulebook.thesis: Only with the 1h trend, entries on 15m pullbacks. Few trades, 5x, wider targets.
rulebook.entry_long: The last six 1h closes are each above the close twelve candles earlier, and the last 15m candle closed higher after at least two lower 15m closes.
rulebook.entry_short: The last six 1h closes are each below the close twelve candles earlier, and the last 15m candle closed lower after at least two higher 15m closes.
rulebook.no_trade: The 1h closes of the last six candles alternate direction.
